rest.text: REST, GraphQL with a schema browser, gRPC through reflection or .proto files, WebSocket, Socket.IO, MQTT, Server-Sent Events, SOAP and MCP in one window.

oauth.text: Basic, bearer, API key, OAuth 1 and 2 with renewal, Digest, AWS SigV4, NTLM, Akamai EdgeGrid, JWT, ASAP and Hawk.

network.text: JSON, XML, form, multipart and file bodies, a cookie jar, proxy and client certificates, and curl commands pasted straight into a request.

response-viewer.text: JSON tree, HTML, image and PDF previews, headers, cookies, size and timing. Download any body, including binary, or copy it as code in 13 languages, including cURL, Python, Go, Java, C#, Swift and Rust.

scopes.text: Secret variables in your OS keychain, plus global, collection, folder and request scopes, dynamic variables and prompts.

secret-managers.text: Pull values from Vault, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, 1Password, Bitwarden or KeePassXC at send time.

runner.text: CSV and JSON data, parallel runs, HTML and JUnit reports, and a CLI that exits non-zero on failure.

mock.text: Serve saved examples or an OpenAPI spec locally, with rules and a live request log.

git-panel.text: Diff, commit, push, branches, stash and conflict resolution, in the desktop app.

folder-workspace.text: Nested collections, tabs and history, kept as plain YAML files in a folder or in app storage.

import.text: Import Postman, OpenAPI, Insomnia, HAR, WSDL, Bruno collections, .http files and curl commands. Export to Postman, OpenAPI, Markdown, .http files or a backup.

agents.text: An MCP server with secret redaction and a host allowlist, and a web version with nothing to install.

postman.text: Free plan; paid from $9 a month.

bruno.text: Free plan; Pro $6, Ultimate $11 a month.

insomnia.text: Free plan; Pro $12, Enterprise $45 a month.

postman.text: Shared Vault from Solo; vault integrations on Enterprise.

bruno.text: Git push and data files on Pro; secret managers on Ultimate.

insomnia.text: Git Sync free for up to 3 users; vaults on Enterprise.
